# Security policy

Lictory stores sensitive organizational knowledge: unreleased plans,
architecture, security reviews and delivery credentials. We take reports
seriously.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/chricarp/lictory/security/advisories/new) for this
repository. Do not open a public issue, pull request or discussion.

Include what is affected, how to reproduce it, and the impact you observed.
Cross-organization data access, authorization bypasses, authentication flaws
and exposure of delivery or AI credentials are the most valuable reports.

Do not access, modify or retain data that is not yours, and do not test against
other organizations' workspaces. Use your own account and organization, or a
local installation.

We will acknowledge the report, keep you informed while we investigate and fix
it, and credit you when the fix ships unless you prefer otherwise. Please give
us a reasonable opportunity to remediate before any public disclosure.
